solution:
A fiasco is a total failure, especially one that becomes embarrassing.

पूर्ण असफलता या बुरी तरह विफलता।

fiasco = total failure

failure • disaster • debacle • catastrophe

question: A long pole on which a flag is flown.
solution:
A flagstaff is the pole used to hold or display a flag.

वह लंबा डंडा/खंभा जिस पर झंडा लगाया जाता है।

flag + staff = flag pole

flagpole • pole • standard pole

question: All the plants of a particular area or period.
solution:
Flora refers collectively to the plants of a place or time.

किसी विशेष क्षेत्र या समय में पाए जाने वाले सभी पौधे।

flora = plants; fauna = animals

vegetation • plant life • greenery

question: Stroke of good luck.
solution:
A fluke is an accidental success or lucky occurrence.

अचानक मिली या संयोग से मिली सफलता।

fluke = lucky accident

windfall • chance • lucky break • stroke of luck

question: Counterfeiting of document.
solution:
Forgery is the making or use of a false document intended to deceive.

दस्तावेज की नकली प्रति बनाना या जालसाजी करना।

forge = make a fake

counterfeit • falsification • fraud • imitation

question: Killing/killer of one's brother.
solution:
Fratricide means killing one's brother; it can also refer to the killer.

अपने भाई की हत्या करना।

frater = brother + cide = killing

brother-killing • kin-killing

question: A state of extreme excitement.
solution:
Frenzy is intense excitement or uncontrolled activity.

अत्यधिक उत्तेजना या उन्माद की अवस्था।

frenzy = wild excitement

mania • hysteria • agitation • turmoil

question: Injury to the nose, fingers or toes caused by extreme cold.
solution:
Frostbite is tissue injury caused by severe cold.

बहुत अधिक ठंड के कारण शरीर के किसी हिस्से को होने वाली चोट।

frost + bite = cold injury

cold injury • freezing injury

question: A room or building for showing works of art.
solution:
A gallery is a room or building where art is exhibited.

कलाकृतियाँ प्रदर्शित करने के लिए बनाया गया कमरा या भवन।

gallery = art display

exhibition hall • museum • art space

question: To play games of chance for money.
solution:
To gamble is to risk money or something valuable on a chance result.

पैसे या किसी मूल्यवान वस्तु को अनिश्चित परिणाम पर जोखिम में लगाना।

gamble = risk for chance

bet • wager • stake • speculate

question: Science and art of preparing and appreciating good food.
solution:
Gastronomy concerns the culture, preparation, and appreciation of food.

अच्छे भोजन को बनाने, समझने और पसंद करने का विज्ञान/कला।

gastro = stomach + nomy = knowledge

culinary art • food culture • cuisine studies

question: Extermination of a race or community.
solution:
Genocide means systematic destruction of a people or group.

किसी जाति, समुदाय या समूह का योजनाबद्ध बड़े पैमाने पर विनाश।

geno = group/race + cide = killing

extermination • mass destruction • annihilation

question: The science of earth's history and rocks.
solution:
Geology studies Earth's materials, structure, history, and processes.

पृथ्वी, चट्टानों, उनकी संरचना और इतिहास का विज्ञान।

geo = earth + logy = study

earth science • geoscience

question: A substance that kills germs.
solution:
A germicide is an agent used to destroy germs or microorganisms.

ऐसा पदार्थ जो रोगाणुओं/कीटाणुओं को नष्ट करे।

germ + cide = germ killer

disinfectant • antiseptic • antimicrobial

question: One who eats too much.
solution:
A glutton habitually eats more than is needed.

वह व्यक्ति जो जरूरत से बहुत अधिक खाता हो।

glutton = eats too much

overeater • gourmand • greedy eater

question: Eat fast, noisily and greedily.
solution:
To gobble means to eat something very quickly and eagerly.

बहुत जल्दी, शोर से और लालच के साथ खाना।

gobble = gulp food fast

gulp • devour • wolf down • gorge

question: Done or obtained without payment.
solution:
Gratis means free of charge; gratuitous can also mean given without payment.

बिना पैसे के दिया या प्राप्त किया गया।

gratis = free

free • complimentary • costless • free of charge

question: Animals that live in flocks.
solution:
Gregarious animals live together in groups; for people, gregarious can mean sociable.

समूह में रहने वाला; झुंड में रहने वाले जीवों के लिए भी प्रयुक्त।

gregarious = group-loving

social • sociable • communal • flocking

question: A drug that causes one to hallucinate.
solution:
A hallucinogen is a substance that can cause hallucinations.

ऐसा पदार्थ जो भ्रम या hallucination उत्पन्न कर सकता है।

hallucination → hallucinogen

psychedelic • mind-altering substance

question: Belief that the most important thing in the world is pleasure.
solution:
Hedonism treats pleasure and enjoyment as the central aim of life.

यह विचार कि जीवन में सुख/आनंद सबसे महत्वपूर्ण लक्ष्य है।

hedonism = pleasure first

pleasure-seeking • sensualism • self-indulgence

question: Faithful supporter.
solution:
A henchman is a trusted follower, often serving a powerful person.

किसी शक्तिशाली व्यक्ति का वफादार समर्थक या अधीनस्थ।

henchman = loyal follower

follower • aide • subordinate • associate

question: Animals which feed on vegetation.
solution:
Herbivorous animals mainly eat plants.

जो मुख्यतः पौधों/वनस्पति को खाता हो।

herbi = plant + vorous = eating

plant-eating • vegetarian • phytophagous

question: Having enormous strength or size.
solution:
Herculean describes something requiring great strength or a huge amount of effort.

बहुत अधिक शक्ति, बल या बड़े आकार वाला; अत्यंत कठिन कार्य के लिए भी।

Hercules → great strength

mighty • gigantic • formidable • colossal

question: Things which contain elements of different nature.
solution:
Heterogeneous means composed of unlike or different parts.

जिसमें अलग-अलग प्रकार या प्रकृति के तत्व मिले हों।

hetero = different

mixed • diverse • varied • dissimilar

question: A plane figure with six sides and angles.
solution:
A hexagon has six sides and six angles.

छह भुजाओं और छह कोणों वाली आकृति।

hexa = six + gon = angle

six-sided polygon • six-angle figure

question: Large scale destruction by fire.
solution:
In the source's vocabulary sense, holocaust refers to large-scale destruction, especially by fire; the term also has a specific historical meaning in modern usage.

स्रोत के अर्थ में बड़े पैमाने पर विनाश, विशेषकर आग से; आधुनिक संदर्भ में इसका एक विशिष्ट ऐतिहासिक अर्थ भी है।

holocaust = great destruction

devastation • destruction • conflagration • massacre

question: Murder or murderer of a man.
solution:
Homicide means the killing of a person by another; legal meaning depends on circumstances.

एक व्यक्ति द्वारा दूसरे व्यक्ति की हत्या/जान से मारना।

homo = human + cide = killing

killing • manslaughter • murder

question: Things which contain elements of the same nature.
solution:
Homogeneous means composed of parts that are alike or uniform.

जिसमें एक ही प्रकार या समान प्रकृति के तत्व हों।

homo = same

uniform • similar • identical • consistent

question: A post for which no salary is paid.
solution:
An honorary position is given as an honour rather than as a paid job.

ऐसा पद जो सम्मान के रूप में दिया जाए और जिसके लिए वेतन न मिले।

honour → honorary

unpaid • titular • ceremonial • nominal

question: Art of growing vegetables, fruit, etc.
solution:
Horticulture is the science and art of cultivating garden crops.

सब्जियों, फलों और बागवानी वाली फसलों को उगाने की कला/विज्ञान।

hortus = garden

gardening • plant cultivation • cultivation

question: Fond of entertaining guests.
solution:
A hospitable person warmly receives and entertains guests.

जो मेहमानों का गर्मजोशी से स्वागत और सत्कार करने वाला हो।

hospitality → hospitable

welcoming • cordial • gracious • friendly

question: Imaginary ailments.
solution:
Hypochondria refers to persistent health anxiety or belief that one is ill despite little evidence.

बीमारी होने की लगातार चिंता या बिना पर्याप्त आधार के स्वयं को बीमार मानने की स्थिति।

hypochondria = imagined illness

health anxiety • illness anxiety • excessive health worry

question: One who opposes established institutions or beliefs.
solution:
An iconoclast questions or attacks established traditions, ideas, or institutions.

जो स्थापित परंपराओं, संस्थाओं या मान्यताओं को चुनौती देता हो।

icon = established image + clast = breaker

nonconformist • rebel • dissenter • maverick
